channel.title: Toolbench Dispatch
channel.description: Marketing tech, SEO and AI search, and developer tools news from Toolbench.

item.title: Google AI Plus subscribers lose Pro model choice in AI Mode on November 13
item.description: Starting November 13, 2026, Google AI Plus subscribers can only pick Flash and Flash-Lite models in the Gemini app and in AI Mode in Google Search. Pro model selection moves to the Google AI Pro plan and above.

item.title: HubSpot reports Q3 2026 revenue of $947.6 million, up 17%
item.description: HubSpot's third quarter 2026 revenue was $947.6 million, up 17% year over year, and it ended September with 311,704 customers, according to its results release filed with the SEC.

item.title: HubSpot sets February 2027 shutdown for design manager serverless functions
item.description: HubSpot is retiring serverless functions built in the design manager and Node.js 20 and earlier for workflow custom code actions. Existing design manager functions stop running on February 1, 2027.

item.title: Chrome DevTools update adds more tools for AI coding agents
item.description: Chrome's November 2026 DevTools update, covering Chrome 155 and 156, expands DevTools for agents with CSS style inspection, configuration file support and chunked trace parsing, and adds a visual position-area editor for CSS anchors.

item.title: Google's September 2026 spam update finished after nearly two weeks
item.description: Google's September 2026 spam update, its fourth spam update of the year, started September 24 and finished on October 8, 2026, a rollout of almost two weeks.

item.title: HubSpot-hosted domains now require TLS 1.2 or newer
item.description: HubSpot automatically raised the minimum TLS version for domains it hosts to TLS 1.2 on October 14, 2026, for accounts that had allowed TLS 1.0 or 1.1. No action was required.

item.title: HubSpot Pipelines API v1 shuts off December 4, 2026
item.description: HubSpot will sunset its Pipelines API v1 on December 4, 2026. Integrations still calling it need to move to a 2026-03 or newer version of the Pipelines API.
